title: Load balancers in 60 seconds
caption: Load balancers in 60 seconds: one address in front, many servers behind it. #devops #backend #cloud

scenes.title: Load balancers
scenes.say: A million visitors, one web address. How?
scenes.sub: A million visitors, one web address. How?

scenes.say: One server can only handle so much. A million users at once, and it falls over.

scenes.heading: One address, many servers
scenes.say: A load balancer sits in front. Everyone connects to it, and it hands each request to one of the servers behind.
It picks a server, and keeps watch.

items.title: Least busy
items.say: Or send it to whoever is least busy.

items.title: Health checks
items.say: And it checks each server, skipping any that stop answering.

scenes.say: That's a load balancer. Many servers, one front door.
